note: Quality thresholds for promoting a role/model route and regression tolerances for changing one. Changing this file is an operator decision; the benchmark is reproducible from packages/evals fixtures (the fixture digest is recorded in every report). A route that misses a threshold is not eligible for that role; a candidate that regresses beyond tolerance versus the recorded baseline is rejected. v1.1 (v2.1 ACT-06): minimums raised to the v2.1 initial qualification targets (builder 0.90, code review 0.90, security review 0.95). These are policy targets, not statistically validated guarantees; qualification additionally requires sample size and uncertainty checks (config/model-qualification.json).
